QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_21

question.text: The purpose of a High-Water Mark (HWM) is to:

answer.text: Ensure no incentive fees is paid on losses made in any year

explanation.text: The Logic: HWM ensures the manager earns incentive fees only on genuine NEW gains, not on recovering past losses, protecting investors. The Trap: HWM does not guarantee returns or cap mgmt fees; insurance is a separate product. Cross-Exam Context: Standard concept across hedge funds and alternative strategies. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Without a HWM clause, investors may end up paying twice on the same recovered gain — always insist on HWM.
